name: Mercure Rayong Lomtalay Villas & Resort
short_description: A two-wing beach resort 2.5 hours from Bangkok, with sea-view villas in the Ocean Wing and a rooftop bar in the Garden Wing, holding a 4.4/5 ALL Rating (2,204 reviews).
ai_summary: Mercure Rayong Lomtalay Villas & Resort is roughly 2.5 hours from Bangkok in Klaeng, Rayong province, and holds a strong 4.4/5 ALL Rating from 2,204 reviews. The property is split into two wings 400 metres apart, connected by a free shuttle: the beachfront Ocean Wing with sea-view villas, and the Garden Wing, 200 metres from the beach, home to the Koh 17 rooftop bar. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 235 Moo 3, Tambon Kram, Amphur Klaeng, 21190 Rayong, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Strong 4.4/5 ALL Rating from a large base of 2,204 reviews
Two distinct wings — beachfront sea-view villas (Ocean Wing) and a rooftop bar (Garden Wing, Koh 17) — connected by a free shuttle
Genuine coastal villa-resort format on Rayong's Eastern Seaboard coastline
cons: 2.5-hour drive from Bangkok — a genuine trip rather than a quick getaway
The two-wing layout means guests should check which wing they're booking for beachfront vs. rooftop-bar proximity
research_highlights: Ocean Wing (beachfront villas) and Garden Wing (Koh 17 rooftop bar), 400m apart with free shuttle
